title: Community care booking · user-path storyboard
subtitle: Keep preconditions, visible states, the main path, branches, and exceptions reviewable in one flow
footer: Cross-industry simulated input · proposed branches and exceptions still need observation
persona: A caregiver arranging a care service
goal: Find the next step and complete a booking in one session
assumptions: Original cross-industry teaching content; it is not a medical workflow or service promise

states.label: Entry
states.detail: The question is clear enough to start

states.label: Triage
states.detail: The request is classified and completed

states.label: Match
states.detail: Available services and constraints are visible

states.label: Follow-up
states.detail: Confirmation and a next entry point are provided

steps.action: Open the service entry and describe the care need
Ask for service type, place, and available time
Review the summary and add missing information
steps.result: The request is complete or needs human help

steps.action: Show eligible services and their constraints
Confirm time, contact, and privacy notice
Submit the request and show processing status
Provide confirmation code, change entry, and human contact
steps.result: The caregiver knows what happens next

branches.label: Human help needed
branches.condition: The caregiver cannot complete the step alone

exceptions.label: No slot available
exceptions.recovery: Choose another time or transfer to a person

exceptions.label: Submission failed
exceptions.condition: A network or service error is returned
